architecture: Frozen ImageNet MobileNetV2 + Dense(128) + Dropout(0.35) + Softmax
input: RGB float pixels in [0,255]; preprocessing is inside saved model
augmentation: One extra random flip/rotation view per training image, cached as features; none on validation or test
limitations: Softmax scores are not calibrated probabilities of correctness
Exact duplicates removed; near-duplicate/leaf-level grouping unavailable
Random image-level split, not farm/plant/source-level split
